name: Lakeside
seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in Lakeside, CA 2026
seo_desc: Kids' Christmas in Lakeside, CA: Spirit of Christmas on Maine Ave, Snow Day at Lindo Lake, Construction Christmas at Oma's and a Yuletide festival.
lede: Lakeside keeps an old fashioned, hometown Christmas: a tree lighting at the Olde Church on Maine Avenue, real snow at Lindo Lake, and a farm Christmas and the already listed Yuletide Medieval Festival out on El Monte Road.
celebrates: The Lakeside Chamber of Commerce closes Maine Avenue for Spirit of Christmas, an afternoon of children's activities, craft booths, youth performances and holiday shopping, with the Community Tree Lighting and Santa's arrival at the Lakeside Historical Society. The Historical Society also runs its Mrs. Claus Christmas Resale Shoppe each December. County Parks brings snow and sledding to Lindo Lake County Park for Snow Day, and the Lakeside Library throws a Polar Express Holiday Party. Out on El Monte Road, Oma's Family Farm turns into Construction Christmas and El Monte County Park hosts the Yuletide Medieval Festival, which already has its own page on this site.
lastyear: In 2025 the Lakeside Chamber of Commerce held its 27th annual Spirit of Christmas on Saturday, December 6, on Maine Avenue. San Diego County Planning and Development Services staff attended the event as part of the county's Lakeside MOVES transportation project. Afterward the event's own Facebook page shared the 2025 Tree Lighting Ceremony as seen from the front porch of the Olde Community Church and called it a fun evening for all.
facts: Lakeside became a town site in 1886 as a tourist destination, built around the Lakeside Inn, which advertised boating, hunting, fishing and plain old relaxing. That makes 2026 the town's 140th anniversary. The Lakeside Historical Society was founded in 1972 and works out of the restored 19th century Olde Community Church at Maine Avenue and Parkside Street, the same spot where the community tree is lit each December. Lakeside is an unincorporated community of San Diego County.
trains: Lakeside once had its own railroad depot, which still appears on the Historical Society's self guided walking tour of the historic district. Today the nearest MTS trolley stops are in neighboring El Cajon and Santee: the Green and Orange Lines reach the El Cajon Transit Center, and the Copper Line runs from there to Santee. For a Christmas train ride, the Pacific Southwest Railway Museum in Campo runs its North Pole Limited farther east, and the Poway-Midland Railroad offers rides at Old Poway Park.

kidfact: Lakeside started in 1886 as a vacation spot. People came to stay at the Lakeside Inn and go boating and fishing on the lake.
faq: When is the Lakeside Christmas tree lighting?

The Community Tree Lighting is part of the Lakeside Chamber of Commerce's Spirit of Christmas on Maine Avenue, held on the first Saturday in December. The Lakeside Historical Society leads the ceremony at 5 pm at the Olde Church, and Santa arrives at the same time. Activities and booths open at 3 pm.
Is Spirit of Christmas in Lakeside free?

Yes. The Lakeside Chamber of Commerce lists admission as free to everyone. Vendors and clubs rent booths, and the chamber asks each booth to provide an activity, craft or other attraction for children. Families can also take photos with Santa and Mrs. Claus and mail letters at the North Pole mailbox.
Where can kids play in snow near Lakeside?

County of San Diego Parks and Recreation holds Snow Day at Lindo Lake County Park, 12660 Lindo Lane, each December. The county brings in fresh snow for sledding and adds photos with Santa, games and arts and crafts. The county lists it as a free event for all ages.
